LESSON: READING 7.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: FICTION AND NON-FICTION TEXTS (1000- 1250 WORDS) POEMS (NOT MORE THAN 5 STANZAS)

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non-Fiction Texts (1000- 1250 words) Poems (not more than 5 stanzas)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non-Fiction Texts (1000- 1250 words) Poems (not more than 5 stanzas), part of Strand 7 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: What kind of information do you find in books? 2. Why is it necessary to read many books? 3. What do you consider when choosing a material to read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. skim through reading materials to obtain the main idea,

2. preview texts to determine suitability and relevance,

3. scan materials for specific details collaboratively,

4. select appropriate reading materials from a library,

5. read the selected materials individually,

6. share reflections on the books read collaboratively,

7. keep a record of materials read. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. skim through reading materials to obtain the main idea,
2. preview texts to determine suitability and relevance,
3. scan materials for specific details collaboratively,
4. select appropriate reading materials from a library,
5. read the selected materials individually,
6. share reflections on the books read collaboratively,
7. keep a record of materials read. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non-Fiction Texts (1000- 1250 words) Poems (not more than 5 stanzas) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration is enhanced as the learner scans materials for specific details collaboratively,

• Learning to Learn is developed as the learner selects appropriate reading materials from a library.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner cooperates and assists one another to select appropriate reading materials.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective Communication is realised in the learner as they read the selected materials individually.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the skill of extensive reading to select and read non-fiction materials in all the learning areas.
